profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React • TypeScript • Node.js • AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer with 9 years of experience building internal platforms, web applications, APIs, and cloud services. My core stack includes React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

At Capital One, I’ve led development of independently deployable services for an internal developer platform that became an enterprise deployment standard used by thousands of engineers. I also built an AWS recovery workflow that cut recurring, multi-hour incident recovery to minutes. More recently, I’ve built registration and integration features for an internal learning platform, connecting complex business rules, PostgreSQL data, Lambda APIs, and accessible React interfaces.

I enjoy working across the stack: making sound architecture decisions, writing thorough tests, improving developer workflows, and mentoring engineers. As an instructor with Capital One Developer Academy, I’ve helped early-career engineers grow into production work. I’ve also brought AI-assisted development into my engineering workflow through detailed implementation specs and custom agent tools.

I’m interested in senior full-stack engineering roles where I can build useful products, strengthen the systems behind them, and help a team do its best work.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer II – Capital One Tech College
positions.description:
• Build full-stack features for a new internal learning platform used by Capital One Tech College program organizers to coordinate learning sessions, registrations, and program operations.
• Designed and implemented a multi-constraint registration system using React, TypeScript, tRPC, AWS Lambda, and PostgreSQL, supporting real-time availability, qualification rules, and scheduling conflict detection.
• Introduced spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflows using Claude Code and Windsurf, including custom agents and reusable commands for component implementation, QA, and recurring engineering tasks.
• Architected reusable UI patterns for error handling, including inline banners, modal overlays, and global toast notifications, then coordinated adoption across the application.
• Integrated external REST APIs through OAuth-authenticated TypeScript clients and AWS Secrets Manager, building resilient UI contracts that remain stable when downstream services change or become unavailable.
• Expanded automated test coverage through major API contract changes, adding hundreds of lines of API and UI tests and updating more than 40 dependent test files.
• Demoed platform capabilities to stakeholders and program organizers, helping grow the product from an initial pilot into a platform supporting multiple active programs and coordinators.
• Selected for an enterprise OpenAI Codex pilot to evaluate developer workflow integration, engineering patterns, and potential organizational adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Instructor – Capital One Developer Academy (CODA)
positions.description:
• Served as both a software engineer and instructor within Capital One Developer Academy (CODA), combining hands-on product engineering with technical mentorship and curriculum development.
• Taught software engineering concepts through real-world development scenarios, authored new learning material, graded projects, and mentored two cohorts of six early-career engineers each year.
• Developed expertise with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Windsurf and helped translate emerging AI-assisted engineering practices into internal curriculum and development workflows.
• Built accessible, tested UI components for Capital One Tech College’s internal learning platform.
• Organized internal AI hackathons and prototyped LLM-powered capabilities while evaluating tooling within enterprise security, compliance, and governance constraints.
• Continued mentoring CODA graduates as they transitioned from the academy into production engineering roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Internal Developer Platform (DevNav)
positions.description:
• Led development of internal developer platform capabilities used to improve release readiness, deployment visibility, automation, and data lineage across Capital One engineering teams.
• Built independently deployable microservices using Lit, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL while integrating with PagerDuty, Jenkins, ServiceNow, and internal platform APIs.
• Helped decompose three legacy monoliths into smaller microservices and microfrontends, improving maintainability and independent deployment.
• Built and demoed release-readiness and automation tooling that grew from hundreds of users to become an enterprise deployment standard used by thousands of engineers.
• Supported production deployments through an on-call rotation, diagnosing failed release pipelines and unblocking application teams during active deployments.
• Designed APIs and cross-team integrations to support platform data requirements, including changes to services owned by other engineering organizations.
• Mentored junior engineers and guided four interns through the design and delivery of a Go CLI, providing architectural guidance, code reviews, and technical coaching.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built a serverless AWS recovery workflow using Lambda and Step Functions that automatically reconstructed deleted ECS clusters from existing platform data.
• Reduced a recurring recovery process from multi-hour, multi-team incident calls to an automated process completed within minutes and requiring no application-owner intervention.
• Expanded a modular Jenkins pipeline library to support Kotlin, Scala, and Python applications, allowing engineering teams to assemble reusable CI/CD components for their technology stack.
• Partnered with application teams across multiple organizations to gather requirements, validate pipeline functionality, and enable self-service adoption.
• Added monitoring capabilities across ECS environments through CloudFormation updates and developed dashboards for platform health and application onboarding.
• Used platform telemetry and operational data to support broader adoption of internal developer tooling across the organization.

positions.title: Technology Development Program (TDP) – Associate Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a Java Spring Boot service to process and catalog JSON and Parquet metadata during a large-scale on-premises-to-cloud data migration.
• Created audit visibility into transferred datasets, helping engineering teams validate and track data throughout the cloud migration process.
• Developed early experience with backend services, structured data, APIs, and enterprise-scale cloud migration within Capital One’s engineering organization.

positions.description: Keep members updated via social media through Facebook posts and sharing photos on Instagram. I am also responsible for sending out a weekly newsletter.

positions.description: I meet with students one-on-one when they need help in their introductory courses to help them get caught up.
